snippet.title: HushWood - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🌲 Wishlist HushWood on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4842880/HushWood/

Become the new ranger of a remote forest reserve. Patrol the woods, photograph unusual discoveries, complete your daily reports... 
and remember, everything is perfectly normal.

💬 Join our Discord:
https://discord.gg/c6ZwcD4PS

Music: 
Fog Lake - side effects
Paweł Spychała - Metamorphosis.mp3
